problem.title: Merge Intervals
problem.statement: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping intervals that cover all of the input. Intervals that touch (one ends where the next starts) overlap. Return them in any order.

events.text: I need to merge overlapping intervals and return the merged list. Up to 10^4 intervals, unsorted, and touching ones like [1,4],[4,5] count as overlapping.
Good. What's your first approach, and its complexity?
I'll sort by start, then extend the last merged interval while the next one starts before it ends.
Before you code: what input would break a naive version of that?
For touching intervals, should my overlap check be start <= last_end or start < last_end?
Think it through and tell me your answer.
